subject.title: Control UI: upload agent avatars from Agents tab

question: Should OpenClaw add a workspace-persistent Agents-tab avatar upload RPC/UI, and if so what storage, validation, auth scope, overwrite, identity-precedence, and serving policy should it use?
rationale: The feature is useful, but it crosses a new authenticated file-upload and workspace-write boundary that automation should not define without maintainer intent.

options.title: Approve bounded upload design
options.body: Add a narrow admin upload path that stores validated image files under the agent workspace, updates canonical identity metadata, and preserves the existing avatar read protections.

options.title: Keep current manual/local paths
options.body: Continue supporting CLI/config/IDENTITY.md and browser-local Quick Settings overrides without adding server-side upload risk.

options.title: Defer to broader workspace design
options.body: Wait for a maintained workspace file-management design before adding avatar-specific writes.

recommendation.title: Approve bounded upload design
recommendation.body: Add a narrow admin upload path that stores validated image files under the agent workspace, updates canonical identity metadata, and preserves the existing avatar read protections.

likelyOwner.reason: He has the strongest combined history across avatar support, avatar safety hardening, and the read-only workspace/Gateway boundary.
